title: Gateway record (one line of reps/<n>/gateway.jsonl)
description: One record per POST whose request line and headers parse (GET /v1/models is answered locally and not recorded). The gateway has a single upstream and always forwards to the pinned model. Request and response bodies are stored only as hashes.

seq.description: Assigned in arrival order. Records are appended when a request completes, so with concurrent requests the file is not sorted by seq.

outcome.description: ok: answered by the model and counted. upstream_rejected: the provider answered 400, 413 or 422 (for example, context too long); passed through, the attempt goes on. budget_exhausted: answered by the gateway because the rep's budget is spent. bad_request: never forwarded, because the request was invalid, could not be handled before admission, or was still unadmitted at shutdown. usage_unknown: forwarded, but the gateway stopped waiting before the provider finished (nothing for the read timeout at any point after sending, before or after the response headers or first stream events: answered 504, or a started stream ends with an upstream_timeout error event; or still in flight when the shutdown drain ended); never retried; the provider may have billed tokens that are not in usage or totals; the attempt goes on. upstream_failed: a provider-side or setup failure (retries exhausted, 401/403/404 or another unexpected status, a connection lost after the request was fully sent, a broken stream, usage that cannot be counted, a gateway fault after admission); the attempt is void, later chat requests are answered locally with this outcome, and the toolkit re-runs the attempt. Sealed bundles contain no upstream_failed records. A request whose answer was already decided when the shutdown drain ended keeps that outcome, a void included.

http_status.description: The status the gateway returned to the harness; 503 for a request abandoned at shutdown before its answer was decided or sent.

upstream_attempts.description: 1 + transparent retries (connection failures before the request was fully sent, 408, 429, 5xx). Nothing is retried once the request was fully sent. 0 when the gateway answered without contacting the provider.

model_rewritten.description: True when the request named a model other than the pinned one. It was served by the pinned model either way.

input_tokens.description: All prompt tokens, including cached ones.

arguments_valid_json.description: How many of the returned tool calls had arguments that parse as a JSON object.

request_sha256.description: Hash of the bytes sent to the provider, or of the bytes received from the harness when nothing was sent.

response_sha256.description: Hash of the bytes received from the provider in the final attempt (before any usage-only chunk was removed), or of the gateway's own answer when nothing was forwarded. The hash of empty input when a forwarded request received no response.

totals.description: Rep-wide counters as the gateway used them for budget enforcement, taken after this request's own usage was counted and before its answer was complete. With concurrent requests they can include other requests.
